title: Large Language Models (LLMs) as Agents for Augmented Democracy

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the predictive accuracy of fine-tuned LLMs on user policy preferences across different self-reported political ideologies (liberal, conservative, centrist).
Comparing the model's predictive accuracy of individual policy preferences between college-educated and non-college-educated participants.
Evaluating differences in the predictive accuracy of the LLMs when forecasting policy preferences for younger participants (bottom quartile) versus older participants (top quartile).
Comparing the predictive accuracy of LLMs on the policy preferences of self-reported male versus female participants.
